verified_subsystems.system: In-Game AI Tactics & Ball Distribution Controller
assembly: 0x141226968: mov byte ptr [rdi + 0x2dd], r8b ; store SHOT_TENDENCY into AI controller
0x141226976: mov byte ptr [rdi + 0x2de], dl ; store TOUCHES into AI controller
0x14122698b: sub edx, 5 ; equilibrium clamp lower bound
0x141226998: cmovl ecx, eax ; clamp shot_tendency within +/-5 margin of touches
verified_subsystems.formula_interpretation: Ensures player shot tendency does not deviate by more than +/-5 from assigned Touches rating. Prevents unassigned/low-usage players from dominating possessions.

assembly: 0x141745116: mov dword ptr [rbp + 0xe0], eax ; snapshot entry 0 for player
0x141745124: mov dword ptr [rbp + 0xe4], eax ; snapshot entry 1 for player
verified_subsystems.formula_interpretation: Sequentially extracts all 99 player tendencies into the simulation roster context. Player stride is 0x27c (636 bytes), storing tendencies at offset 0xe0..0x268.
coupled_fields: All 99 Player Tendencies in continuous sequence 0x458..0x4BA

assembly: 0x1419b52dd: cvtdq2ps xmm0, xmm0 ; convert tendency to float
0x1419b52e0: mulss xmm0, xmm6 ; multiply by coach tempo/pace scale factor in xmm6
0x1419b52e4: movss dword ptr [rbx + 0xfc], xmm0 ; store dynamic weighted shot probability
verified_subsystems.formula_interpretation: P_shot = (ShotTendency / 100.0) * CoachPaceFactor(xmm6). When coach Pace > 75, xmm6 > 1.15, accelerating shot decision speed.

assembly: 0x1419b9ce6: mulss xmm6, dword ptr [rip + 0x86416e] ; multiply by global slider weight
verified_subsystems.formula_interpretation: Modulates raw tendency by global simulation sliders before possession resolution.
